shots.prompt: The camera tilts down away from her face. Her white gauntlet comes into the bottom of the frame and grips the wooden spear shaft, and her fingers tighten once around it.
The camera pulls back slowly. The woman in the white armour steps out of the doorway into the rain and stops two paces from the man in the red coat.
The camera holds steady on the two of them. The woman in the white armour speaks one short sentence and the man in the red coat lowers his head.
The camera moves in on the man in the red coat. His face fills the frame, he blinks, and rain runs from his dark hair down his cheek.
The camera rises straight up above the gate and looks down. The two figures stand small on the wet stones below and the lantern swings once on its hook.
The camera tilts up along the spear held in her white gauntlet until the steel tip fills the top of the frame. Rain runs down the shaft and drips off the point.
The camera holds. The woman in the white armour turns and walks into the dark doorway; the man in the red coat stays where he is and watches her go.
